Answer: C
Reason: The imaging demonstrates Scimitar syndrome, characterized by a right-sided anomalous pulmonary vein (scimitar vein) running parallel to the right heart border and an abnormal systemic arterial supply from the inferior aorta (indicated by the arrow in Figure 1). This condition is classically associated with right lung hypoplasia, which causes deviation of the mediastinum and heart to the right.
